findings.title: Discount rate is a float instead of an int
findings.body: The function `apply_discount` expects `percent` to be an `int` (as shown in its signature), but `rate` is set to `0.2` (a float) on line 14. Passing a float to an `int` parameter can lead to unexpected behavior or type errors. Use an integer rate (e.g., `20` for 20%) to match the expected type.

summary.problem: The discount rate in `spring_price_cents` is a float, but the `apply_discount` function expects an integer, which may cause type mismatches or runtime errors.
summary.done_well: The new function `spring_price_cents` correctly uses the imported `apply_discount` to compute the discounted price.
